title: Pico (clang, permissive)
comment: PERMISSIVE (non-GPL) clang/LLVM replacement for the GPL pico-toolchain (src/arm-gcc). clang.wasm replaces cc1plus (frontend + integrated-as), lld.wasm replaces ld, compiler-rt (Apache-2.0) replaces libgcc, picolibc (BSD) replaces newlib. WIP: proves the clang -> lld -> compiler-rt + picolibc chain emits valid armv6-m/armv8-m ELF (e_machine 40) + UF2; the arduino-pico core recompiled-with-clang is NOT yet built (see docs).
